name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: A month calendar for single dates, continuous ranges or multiple picks. Months slide in from the direction you travel (chevrons or a swipe), the title flips to a month / year grid, selected days pop with a spring and ranges draw one band with rounded ends that wraps across weeks. Locale-aware weekday and month names via Intl, Sunday or Monday weeks, min / max / custom disabled days, a today ring, coloured event dots and whole-day colour highlights. Day tiles follow the kit radius — square at 0, circles from 16 up.
summary: A month calendar where months slide in from the side you travel and ranges draw one band.
behavior: Tap a day to select it. Swipe sideways or use the chevrons to change month, and tap the title for a month and year grid.
Months slide in with a spring, selected days pop with a bouncy spring and range bands fade in.
Days are buttons with selected and disabled state, labelled with the full date plus "today" or "has events" where they apply.
props: Selection model; decides the value type.
Controlled selection (Date for single, DateRange for range, Date[] for multiple).
Fires on every tap. Range fires { start, end: null } first, then both ends.
Controlled visible month (any date inside it).
Called with the first day of the month navigated to.
BCP 47 locale for month and weekday names.
Earliest selectable day; also limits navigation.
Latest selectable day; also limits navigation.
Up to three coloured dots under each day, keyed by toDateKey(date) (YYYY-MM-DD).
Fills whole days with a colour (birthdays, shifts, people), keyed by toDateKey(date). Text switches to a readable colour on top.
tiles puts every day of the month on a soft tile; minimal shows bare numbers with a hover / press circle.
Weekday header as single letters (M T W) or short names (Mon Tue Wed), via Intl.
Shows a Today pill in the header whenever another month is on screen; tapping it jumps back.
Show faded days of the neighbouring months (tapping one navigates there).
Always render six week rows so the height never changes.
Tap the title for a month grid, tap again for a year grid.
Most dates selectable in multiple mode.
